title: THE CIGARILLOS
tickerText:
*** GO SEE THEM LIVE!! ***

THE CIGARRILLOS ARE A RAUCOUS TWO-PIECE FROM NAARM/MELBOURNE. THEIR MISSION IS TO DELIVER A CELEBRATION OF THEIR LOVE OF TRADITIONAL BLUES WITH A HEAVY INFUSION OF DRIVING GARAGE ROCK, SERVED VIA THEIR SIGNATURE COMBO OF PRIMAL DRUMS, SLATHERED WITH FUZZY GUITAR TONES AND TOPPED WITH GUTSY VOCALS.
